title: Decision: too-deep JMAP request JSON gets notJSON
description: RFC 8620 §3.6.1 (rfc8620.txt L1090-1104) has no request error for exceeding a nesting-depth limit. Readings: notJSON (L1092 'did not parse as I-JSON'; RFC 8259 §9 lets a parser limit nesting depth), notRequest (L1095; but refusal happens before parsing completes), limit (L1100-1103; only for limits defined on the capability object, and depth is not one). Chosen (Mark, 2026-10-19): notJSON. MAX_REQUEST_DEPTH = 32 is an INVENTED value (.11.2).
